materials.title: Our Materials
materials.desc: Every marble and stone we work with. Each slab is unique, so veining and tone vary from piece to piece.

about.bodyText1: Skevos began with a simple idea: everyday kitchen objects deserve the same material honesty as fine furniture. We work directly with Greek marble and travertino, letting each stone's natural veining and colour define the finished piece.
about.bodyText2: Every spoon rest is cut, shaped and polished by hand. Because the material is natural, no two pieces are identical — the marks and tones you see are the stone's, not ours.
about.bodyText3: We keep the range narrow and the quality high: one considered form, offered across the widest range of stone colour we can responsibly source.

quarried.title: Quarried
quarried.desc: Blocks are selected by hand for colour and veining before they ever reach the workshop.

shaped.title: Shaped
shaped.desc: Each rest is cut and hollowed to its basin form, then refined by hand.

polished.title: Polished
polished.desc: A food-safe sealant is applied and the surface polished to its final finish.

spoon-rest.name: Spoon Rest

coaster-heart.description: Heart-shaped coasters cut from a single marble slab — a small, considered gift for the table.

coaster-spindle.name: Coaster Set with Spindle

coaster-hexagon.name: Hexagon Coasters with Stand
coaster-hexagon.description: Hexagonal marble coasters with a slotted stand that holds them upright on the counter.

coaster-triangle.name: Triangle Coasters

coaster-square.name: Square Coasters with Stand
coaster-square.description: Square marble coasters with a matching slotted stand.

coaster-wave.name: Wave Coasters with Stand
coaster-wave.description: Coasters with a scalloped top edge, stored upright in a solid marble holder.

tray-handles.name: Serving Tray

bowl-small.name: Small Bowl

plate-round.name: Round Plate Set

candlestick-block.name: Block Candlesticks

candlestick-hexagon.name: Hexagon Candlesticks
candlestick-hexagon.description: Faceted hexagonal marble candlesticks in three heights.

candlestick-tapered.name: Tapered Candlesticks
candlestick-tapered.description: Gently tapered marble candlesticks in three heights.

tealight-block.name: Tea Light Blocks

fluted-plate.name: Fluted Decorative Plate

finishInfo.travertino-classic: A light, warm beige travertine with soft bands running through it. Calm and natural, it suits both rustic and modern kitchens.
finishInfo.travertino-choco: A rich brown travertine with layered bands of chocolate and taupe. Warm and earthy, with plenty of natural movement.
finishInfo.green: A deep forest-green marble with darker clouds and fine light veins. Bold and striking, every piece looks different.
finishInfo.red: A deep red marble crossed by bright white veins. Dramatic and full of character, it stands out on any table.
finishInfo.perla: A soft ivory marble with faint golden veining. Gentle and elegant, it brings warmth without drawing attention.
finishInfo.nero-greco: A black marble with fine white and gold veins. Elegant and dramatic, it makes light-coloured food stand out.
finishInfo.salomi: A white marble with bold grey veins sweeping across it. Lively and graphic, with strong movement.
finishInfo.semi-white: A soft white marble with cloudy grey veining. Light and calm, with a subtle play of tones.
finishInfo.rodiths: An almost pure white marble with a very even, quiet surface. Clean and minimal.
finishInfo.maroko-sand: A sandy beige stone with small natural pores and specks. Warm and textured, close to the feel of raw stone.
finishInfo.maroko-stoned: A beige stone filled with pebble-like shapes in grey and cream. Full of texture, no two pieces alike.
finishInfo.delino: A white marble with waves of golden beige. Soft and warm, with gentle flowing movement.
finishInfo.foume: A grey marble with dark, smoky streaks. Moody and dynamic, with deep contrast.
finishInfo.white: A pure white marble with only the faintest veining. Bright, clean and timeless.
finishInfo.blue-gray: A grey marble with a cool blue undertone and soft veins. Calm and refined.
finishInfo.cool-grey: A light, cool grey marble with misty veining. Understated and modern.
finishInfo.dark-grey: A dark grey marble with lighter streaks running through it. Strong and contemporary.
